name: Calendar date
summary: Tear-off calendar page with a coloured month header, big day number and weekday; can flip from another day.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: color
params.note: header colour; default the style's accent

params.name: from
params.note: optional: the day the page flips from; the page collapses to reveal day

author: krakujs
